events.verdict: Mitchell (CLE) deflects the ball away from da Silva (ORL).
Mitchell (CLE) briefly grasps da Silva's (ORL) arm as they pursue the loose ball.
Merrill (CLE) makes contact with Bane's (ORL) arm and affects his jump shot attempt.
Mobley (CLE) initiates contact with Carter Jr.'s (ORL) arm and affects his shot attempt.
Bane (ORL) establishes his right foot as his pivot foot, which he moves after his gather.
Harden (CLE) is bracing for the contact from Banchero (ORL) and he releases away from the contact.
Mobley (CLE) establishes himself in da Silva's (ORL) path prior to the contact.

da Silva (ORL) makes contact with the ball, and with the part of Mitchell's (CLE) hand that is on the ball, as he defends the jump shot.  Any contact to Mitchell's arm that occurs while da Silva is in contact with the ball is considered marginal.
Harden (CLE) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Magic.
Ellis (CLE) legally contests Bane's (ORL) jump shot attempt.
Carter Jr. (ORL) legally contests Mitchell's (CLE) jump shot attempt.  Any contact that occurs is the result of Mitchell raising his leg/knee towards Carter Jr. during his shooting motion.
Merrill (CLE) commits a take foul on Bane (ORL).
Suggs (ORL) legally contests Mitchell's (CLE) jump shot attempt.
Ellis (CLE) commits a take foul on da Silva (ORL).
